opening.argument: The video directs viewers to join BitClub through a required sponsor referral and presents the network as “THE MOST INNOVATIVE AND LUCRATIVE WAY TO EARN BITCOIN.” The demonstrated account flow then requires payment of a "$99 Membership" to activate participation. After that payment step, the member dashboard displays a “NEXT PAYOUT,” cryptocurrency balances, and “Mining Earnings,” connecting paid membership to recurring mining-related returns. The combination of sponsor-led enrollment, a lucrative Bitcoin-earning pitch, required paid activation, and displayed mining and payout features establishes the promoted paid-return scheme.
